criteria.criterion: A new test in crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs: item a fails twice, the scope guard then reports its line paused, and drain::drain runs the next queued item. It asserts the next item is read, run and landed, report.stop is not Stop::RepeatedFailure, and report.failed_item is None. Check with `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`.
criteria.evidence: I ran both commands. Both new tests pass: drain_passes_over_an_item_whose_second_failure_pauses_its_line_and_runs_the_next_item and ..._and_holds_back_what_depends_on_it. The full drain target passed 161 of 161. The first test drives drain::drain with the Stub, which pauses a's line when `a-retry` runs, so the pause comes from the second failure. It asserts the log reaches `read b`, `run b`, `land b`, plus stop == QueueEmpty, stop != RepeatedFailure, failed_item == None and landed == 1. Without the re-check at drain.rs 1814, attempts returns Failed, finish sets RepeatedFailure and b never runs, so these assertions would fail. I worked this out from the code; I did not run the tests against the base.

summary: The change does what the request asks, and the verdict is pass. Before, the batch stopped as a repeated failure even when the item's second failure was what paused its line. Now the drain checks the pause once more after an item's second failed attempt. If the line is paused, the item is passed over with the pause reason and the batch goes on to the next queued item. An unpaused item that fails twice still stops the batch. The check sits where the bug starts, in Drain::attempts, before it returns Failed. It does not classify failures by cause and does not mask failure keys. Two new tests show the next item b is read, run and landed, and that the batch ends with no repeated failure and no failed item. The paused item gets one passed-over line with the pause reason, and items that depend on it are held back. The existing tests for an unpaused item failing twice pass unchanged. I ran the whole drain test target: 161 of 161 passed. Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and test checks also passed. Only the three planned files changed, and the module docs, the Stop::RepeatedFailure description and the CHANGELOG are updated. One minor note: three existing real-steps tests had to be changed to fit the new behavior.
